name: Coke Production/Sintering/Blast Furnace/Basic Oxygen Furnace/On-site Generation and Other Steam Uses and Losses
notes:
This is a combined process that accouts for the Coke Production, Sintering, Blast Furnace, Basic Oxygen Furnace and On-site Generation processes because in Excel each of these individual processes has been normalized to per ton of Steel production even though they may have different products (or outputs). Notes for individual inputs are added to distinguish the acount for each component process. 

Emission data source: Data based on Athena, Cradle-to-gate life cycle inventory: Canadian and US Steel Production by Mill Type, 2002

Input amounts:
Calcium Carbonate (i.e., Limestone): 0.0092 ton in Sintering + 0.0429 ton in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves)=0.0521 ton 
Lime: 0.0628 ton in Basic Oxygen Furance (including Ladles and Caster)
Iron Ore: 0.0024 ton in Sintering + 1.144 ton in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves)=1.1464 ton
Coke: 0.255 mmbtu coke for per ton of coke so for 1.15 ton iron ore 0.2922 mmbtu of coke input
Coke: 1.103 mmBtu Coke in Sintering from pet coke boiler 
Coke: 9.933 mmBtu Coke in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) 
Coke: Input = 11.32791 mmBtu, Output 11.32791 mmBtu, So net output 0 mmBtu
Coal Tar: 0.0285 mmBtu Tar in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves), Output 0.7306 mmBtu, So net output 0.70212 mmBtu, shown as negtive inputs because only energy is displaced
Blast Furnace Gas: 1.167 mmBtu in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves), internal product
Blast Furnace Gas: 0.03 mmBtu in Basic Oxygen Furnace (including Ladles and Caster) + 2.6785 mmBtu in On-site Generation and Other Steam Uses and Losses + 0.03 mmBtu in Coke Production=2.7385 mmBtu, internal product
Blast Furnace Gas: above two is 3.0925 mmBtu, Output is 4.09743 mmBtu, So net output is 0.1915 mmBtu,  shown as negtive inputs because only energy is displaced
Coke Oven Gas: 0.21257 mmBtu in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) + 1.85556 mmBtu in On-site Generation and Other Steam Uses and Losses = 2.06184 mmBtu
Coke Oven Gas: 2.4623 mmBtu in Coke Production
Coke Oven Gas: above two is 4.5304 mmBtu, output is 6.006 mmBtu, so net output is 1.45761 mmBtu, shown as negtive inputs because only energy is displaced
Benzole: 0.26959 mmBtu output, shown as negtive inputs because only energy is displaced
all other inputs are sum of energies used in this process

Output amounts:
Steel: 1 short ton

Residual Oil: represents the displacement credits of Benzole (0.26959 mmBtu) and coal tar (0.70212 mmBtu)

Output special emissions:
VOC: 47.2226 g in Sintering + 1137.4097 g in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) + 0.4725 g in Basic Oxygen Furnace (including Ladles and Caster) + 1472.3507 g in Coke Production = 2657.4555 g 
CO: 3104.9686 g in Sintering + 14731.2899 g in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) + 1645.2414 g in Basic Oxygen Furnace (including Ladles and Caster) + 326.8802 g in coke production= 19808.3801 g 
NOx: 17.1639 g in Sintering + 12.2302 g in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) + 75.6049 g in Basic Oxygen Furnace (including Ladles and Caster) + 175.1144 g in coke production= 280.1134 g 
PM10: 284.908 g in Sintering + 6.3931 g in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) + 218.754 g in Basic Oxygen Furnace (including Ladles and Caster) + 660.4314 g in coke production= 1170.4865 g 
PM25: PM10/2
SOx: 33.6236 g in Sintering + 1218.5738 g in Blast Furnace (Including BF Gas Flaring and Loss and Stoves) + 1008.9925 g in coke production= 2261.1899 g
